computed.method: Polygons returned with outSR=4326 (f=geojson); union and centroid computed in EPSG:32616 and returned to WGS84 (EPSG:6609 cross-check gives the same point to 1e-7 degrees); geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: TierPoint's Milwaukee page gives 'Milwaukee (MKE) 3701 W. Burnham Street, Ste C Milwaukee, WI 53215' with 28,000+ total square feet and 3,600+ square feet of raised floor.

A county query for 37xx W Burnham St returns exactly two parcels addressed 3701 W BURNHAM ST, one on each side of the City of Milwaukee / Village of West Milwaukee line; they adjoin (0.0 m gap, one-part union) and share one company owner of record, so they are treated as one property. The other 37xx parcels (3700-3722 W Burnham St) are small even-numbered lots of 0.08-0.16 acres.
TierPoint's own structured-data point (43.009671, -87.961347) lies inside the union (inside parcel 4571008006), 30.9 m from the selected centroid; it is a cross-check only.
unresolved: The building footprint and the suite (Ste C) are not mapped; the West Milwaukee parcel's legal description still carries a 'VACANT LOT' note, so the building may occupy only part of the two-parcel property.
The county layer publishes no edit date (tax years 2025 and 2024).
